concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-apac-transactions-descriptors]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted APAC-routed descriptor snapshot covering bank-controlled statement presentation, application-derived hard/soft configuration, authorization/pending and settlement/finalization timing, per-transaction dynamic replacement, the separate PayPal-console route and original-dynamic-descriptor reuse for refunds; not proof of current regional or merchant-account eligibility, exact bank rendering, payment success, refund completion or posting timing
warnings: Treat APAC as the document route and snapshot scope, not evidence of eligibility in every APAC market or for any particular merchant account.
The customer's bank controls exact statement rendering; documented descriptor configuration does not guarantee display unchanged.
Keep PayPal descriptor updates on the separate PayPal-console route described by the source.
Refund descriptor reuse does not establish refund completion or bank-posting timing.
